scope: Analytical recomputation of the capped cost from the protected order (exact integer arithmetic, independently reproduced). Toy-walk statistics and Montgomery case counts are produced when the verifier runs experiment.py; no walk outcomes are claimed here. The tower irreducibility conditions (xi=9+u a non-cube in Fp2, v a non-square in Fp6) were verified by direct exponentiation; see machine.md. C validation (executed during development, 2026-11-17, gcc 13.3 -O2 -DCOUNT_OPS): the fixed arithmetic.c harness passes all checks -- v*v^2 = xi = 9+u, w*w = (v, 0), 64/64 aliased fp2_mul_xi calls matching the unaliased result, 32/32 random Fp6 products and 32/32 random Fp12 products matching the independent Python schoolbook reference; one fp12_mul measures 54 mont_mul, 171 add_mod, 109 sub_mod, from which the Fp12 total 54*448+280*32+512 = 33,664 is derived (charged G' = 40,000). The rejected revision's arithmetic.c fails the same harness (v*v^2 = 9+9u, 64/64 aliased calls wrong), confirming the fix addresses the rejection. The experiment re-runs this validation (compiled harness, or a faithful transcription when no compiler exists) and both paths produce identical counts.
